note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only variable assignments (dicts, lists, strings). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines dataset pipelines, dataloaders, evaluators, training schedule, learning rate scheduler, and optimizer settings for COCO instance segmentation with multi-scale training.
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the train_pipeline which defines LoadImageFromFile, LoadAnnotations, RandomResize, RandomFlip, and PackDetInputs steps
summarize_test_pipeline: summarize the test_pipeline which defines LoadImageFromFile, Resize, LoadAnnotations, and PackDetInputs steps
review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader config which sets batch_size=2, uses AspectRatioBatchSampler, and RepeatDataset with 3x repeats
review_param_scheduler: review the param_scheduler which uses LinearLR warmup for 500 iterations then MultiStepLR with milestones at epochs 9 and 11
review_optim_wrapper: review the optim_wrapper which configures SGD with lr=0.02, momentum=0.9, and weight_decay=0.0001
